_how: of_tools' expected values for tools-move-v0 (hand-over d18dc22d), from of_tools.session_config on tools-registry.yaml. $HOME is the lab user's home; $OF_BIN is the resolved path of the `of` that starts the session (~/organic-framework/bin/of in the VM). Each config dir holds one installed plugin, lab-plugin@lab, in plugins/installed_plugins.json, so enabledPlugins is written; without it the key is absent. The same values hold on ~/.claude-a and ~/.claude-b, before and after the move (checks 1 and 2). mcp is the --mcp-config file's content; null means no --mcp-config argument at all (check 3).
canary: check 4: the value of LAB_CANARY appears in no generated .mcp.json or settings file; the file names the credential lab-canary and the variable LAB_CANARY only
